text:
ash: Observed a perf regression after yesterday's autokernel-selector roll. Llama3-13B, short chats (~20-40 tokens) latency +25% p50. Stacktrace/profiler shows an extra KV copy + fallback to generic matmul kernel when SiLU+RMSNorm model is used. Posting profiler excerpt. :eyes:

ash: ```
[prof] 00:00.001 select_kernel: chosen=fused_attention_v2 (fast path)
[prof] 00:00.009 fallback: chosen=generic_matmul (slow path) reason=activation_combo(SiLU,RMSNorm)
[prof] 00:00.020 kv_copy bytes=12MB host->device
[prof] 00:00.045 total_token_time=45ms (expected ~35ms)
```

benchmark-bot: Perf snapshot (canary vs prev):
benchmark-bot: `canary p50=45ms p95=120ms; prev p50=36ms p95=98ms; alloc delta +12%`

sam: Hmm. Does the fallback only happen on short sequences? or also long ones?

ash: Mostly short sequences and when the chat template includes long system/preamble. Suspect KV alignment + head-dim -> fused kernel mismatch. The selector appears to prefer fused for normal head layouts but detects SiLU->incompatible path mid-execution and falls back, triggering copy.

jordan: Could be rope scaling mismatch too — if rope_theta/defaults differ we end up using a different attention codepath. What are model metadata values for rope & head_dim?

ash: Model metadata: hidden_size=5120, heads=32, head_dim=160, rmsnorm=true, activation=silu, rope_theta=10000 (model file says default). Runtime assumed rope base=4096 for some older heuristics; might trigger alternative kernels.

ravi: Quick experiment: force kernel selector to prefer "safe_fused" for these shapes and skip the mid-check. Also try enabling kv_prefetch=true to avoid host->device copy during fallback.

sam: I can run a sweep. Two things to try: (1) override rope_theta to 4096 at load and see latency; (2) switch activation path to treat SiLU as float16-friendly but not fused.

kai: Repro steps I used:
kai: ```bash
# run short chat workload against canary endpoint
wrk -t12 -c200 -d30s "https://canary.redwood/api/v1/generate?model=llama3-13b" -s scripts/short_chat.lua
```
kai: Attached the wrk script and the raw perf logs. The latency spikes correlate with cache-miss events in the trace.

jordan: If rope mismatch is the root cause, changing chat template to strip static long prefixes would help while we fix selector heuristics. Many chat templates add a 600-token system thing which kills short chat perf because KV size grows and selector picks different kernel.

ash: Actionable plan:
ash: 1) sam: run two sweeps (rope override 4096 vs 10000) with kv_prefetch on/off and report p50/p95.
ash: 2) ravi: prototype a selector guard that checks for SiLU+RMSNorm and forces safe_fused or fast_generic w/o extra copy. Put as feature flag.
ash: 3) jordan: audit chat templates for long static prefixes and add a quick filter in console to recommend trimming.

sam: I'll start sweep now, will post numbers in this thread. ETA ~45m. :hourglass_flowing_sand:

ravi: I'll open a draft PR for the selector guard (will include perf microbenchmarks). PR -> #3421.

benchmark-bot: New run (short-chat sweep): canary override_rope=4096 kv_prefetch=true -> p50=37ms p95=105ms. baseline canary (no override) p50=46ms p95=122ms.

ash: Nice. That strongly points to rope default mismatch + kv_prefetch reducing copy penalty.

sam: Confirmed locally: forcing rope_theta=4096 at load regains most of the gap. Also tried disabling fused SiLU kernel and performance stabilized (no fallback). But disabling fused hurts long-run throughput ~3%. Need the selector fix.

jordan: For rollout: revert autokernel-selector on canary for now and deploy selector-guard feature flag to canary with tests.

ash: Agreed. I'll revert the selector rollout and we push Ravi's guard behind flag. After validation we'll land permanent selector heuristics (check head_dim/activation/rope combo).

kai: Filed incident note in incidents channel referencing this thread. Adding logs + wrk artifacts.

sam: Followups: I'll run a longer stability sweep and send sample traces to perf-team. If all green, we re-enable selector with guard.

ravi: Left TODOs in PR for fallback removal once we can guarantee the guard covers combos.

ash: Thanks all. Summary: root cause = mismatch in rope defaults + activation combos triggering fallback -> extra KV copy. Short-term fixes: rope override + kv_prefetch + selector revert. Mid-term: selector heuristics tighten (PR #3421) + console chat-template recommendations. :white_check_mark:
